mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it indicates increased economic activity and potential corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, suggests a stable economic environment conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between low CPIAUCSL and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% each over the last two months signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates increased consumer spending and employment.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and PAYEMS both increase > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint correlation between RSAFS/PAYEMS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% over the last month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% over the same period, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it indicates increased economic activity and consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint correlation between UNRATE/PAYEMS changes and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it encourages investment and borrowing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% despite the signal, or the correlation between low FEDFUNDS and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
